data_description.address: The Bluetooth MAC address of your device

confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

password.description: Enter the Bluetooth password of {name}. The factory default is HiLink.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Move it closer to a Bluetooth adapter or proxy and try again.

abort.no_devices_found: No supported devices found in range; If the device is in range, ensure the scanner has active scanning enabled, as these devices cannot be discovered with passive scans. Active scans can be disabled once the device is configured. If you need clarification on whether the device is in-range, download the diagnostics for the integration that provides your Bluetooth adapter or proxy and check if the MAC address of the device is present.

data_description.retry_count: How many times to retry sending commands to your devices
data_description.new_password: Leave empty to keep the current password. Exactly 6 printable ASCII characters; the device reboots after the change.

error.invalid_password: The password must be exactly 6 printable ASCII characters.
error.change_failed: The device did not accept the new password. Check the connection and try again.
error.not_loaded: The device is not set up yet; wait until it is connected and try again.

operation_error.message: An error occurred while performing the action: {error}

value_error.message: Device initialization failed because of incorrect configuration parameters: {error}
